question:
**Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.**

Sam was looking __gloomy__, and downcast, and Meg in tears.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Buoyant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gloomy **means sad and lacking in energy. (उदास और ऊर्जा की कमी)
 
• **Buoyant **means cheerful and optimistic. (प्रसन्नचित्त और आशावादी)
 
• Therefore, they are antonyms.
 
• The sentence suggests that Sam and Meg were both feeling low, so the opposite of gloomy would be a more positive emotion like buoyant.
 
• Grammatically, "**buoyant**" is an adjective that modifies the subject of the sentence, Sam and Meg, while "**gloomy**" and "downcast" are also adjectives that describe their mood.
 
• Using antonyms correctly can help you understand the meaning of a sentence even if you don't know all the words.

Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Plain **means simple or unremarkable. (सरल या अचूक)
 
• **Sullen **means bad-tempered or sulky. (बुरे स्वभाव वाला या क्रोधी)
 
• **Morose **means gloomy and ill-tempered. (उदास और गुस्सैल)
